log.notes_to_self: Day 1 strategy: probe only forum and foreign, plus safe national; all deaths afternoon preserves night workers, students, and at-home people (55% baseline). Avoid morning, which excludes students. Selected all 5 available national/forum/foreign victims. Even if both kinds accessible and fully established, pool >=3437 absent other evidence. Two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible, fixed but unknown. Use day-3 feedback to infer accessibility before expanding exposure. National traces yield no information; inaccessible-source co-reporting can invalidate traces. Goal later exploit inaccessible categories for high volume and rolling 5-day multipliers without pool <=1000. No inference yet about inaccessible kinds.

Day 2: continued killing only national, forum, and foreign victims (5/day), all quick in afternoon. Total through day 2: 10 kills/points. Afternoon preserves night workers, students, and at-home people (55% baseline). Only forum and foreign exposure keeps pool at least 3437 even if both fully established. Adding a third accessible 25% category could reduce it to 859 and cause capture, so do not expand blindly. Two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible, fixed but unknown. No informative conference yet; initial pool 100000. Day-3 conference will give first feedback, but traces are random and hidden co-reporting can invalidate them; absence of shrinkage does not prove inaccessibility. Need identify safe expansion opportunities to reach rolling five-day multiplier thresholds without pool <=1000. All deaths so far afternoon; never use morning unnecessarily, as it can exclude students.

Through day 3: 15 kills, all national/forum/foreign, all quick afternoon; 15 points expected. Continue preserving students: afternoon allows night workers, students and at-home (55%). Even if forum and foreign are both established, pool >=100000*.55*.25*.25=3437. Adding a third accessible category risks <=1000 (regional/age:859; sector:687), so wait for conference feedback before expanding. Two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible, fixed and unknown. Traces random; hidden extra reporting can block traces or weaken constraints, so lack of shrinkage is not proof of inaccessibility. Day-3 conference should appear tomorrow; use it to assess which forum/foreign constraints have accumulated. Current 5/day cannot reach rolling 30-death multiplier, so seek a safely justified expansion rather than remain at 5 forever. No regional, sector or age victims killed yet.

Day-3 pool rounded to 10000, consistent with 13750 = 55% routines times one 25% readership; suggests only one forum/foreign category has constrained L so far, but NOT proof the other is inaccessible. Continue afternoon only to preserve students, night workers, at-home (55%). Using only national/forum/foreign guarantees pool >=3437 even if both readerships established. A third accessible category could reduce pool below1000; avoid expansion until stronger feedback. Day-6 conference will help distinguish one established readership (roughly10000) from both (roughly3000), though hidden cross-reporting makes inference uncertain. Two inaccessible kinds fixed among regional/sector/age/forum/foreign. No regional, sector or age kills yet. Current five kills/day cannot reach rolling30 multiplier; seek evidence-based expansion if one existing readership appears inaccessible. Major/minor has no stated scoring or tracing effect.
